items.title: Make the doctor global-core-realpath check linked-worktree-aware
items.context: In the doctor implementation (global-core-realpath check, surfaced in handlers/lattice-cli.ts doctor output; locate via rg global-core-realpath packages/main/src): when cwd belongs to a linked git worktree of repository R and the global @lattice/core realpath equals R canonical main checkout packages/main, classify pass (or info) with no repair block; keep warn for genuinely unrelated resolution paths. Regression tests: worktree-context fixture asserts no warn and doctor brief back under the 20000-byte brief-output-smoke budget; unrelated-path fixture still warns. npm test green from inside a worktree is the acceptance signal.
